newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Two killed as Africa penis shrinker scare spreads.
newsitem.headline: Two killed as Africa penis shrinker scare spreads.

text.p: One man was burned to death by an angry mob and a second beaten to death in Ivory Coast's commercial capital after a shrinking or disappearing penis scare spread from neighbouring Ghana, police said on Friday.

One alleged sorcerer was covered in petrol and set alight on Thursday in Abidjan's populous Koumassi suburb and a second beaten to death in Port Bouet on the outskirts of the city. A mob seriously hurt a third man in Marcory suburb.
The independent newspaper Le Jour carried a front-page photograph of the charred Koumassi body and quoted witnesses as saying that the man had been burned as a sorcerer.
At least 12 men were killed in Ghana in January by mobs accusing them of making penises shrink or vanish.

Victims say sorcerers simply touch them and make their penises shrink or vanish by witchcraft to extort cash in return for a cure. Police in Ghana dismissed the phenomenon as a ploy by thieves to cause a crowd to form and then rob people.

Similar cases have been reported in Ivory Coast in recent weeks but until Thursday no deaths. State television carried details of one case on its main evening news on Wednesday, quoting a victim in a light-hearted report.
Such reports are not uncommon in West Africa. Purported victims often blame handshakes with sorcerers.
Residents in Accra recall a similar scare in the early 1980s. They attributed the scale of the crisis there to the fact that genitals are used in certain voodoo rituals.
